      function validateForecast(point, uniqueId, range, index, previousTarget) {

        if (actualPath) svg.append(svgNode("path", { d: actualPath, class: "chart-line", "data-kind": "actual", "data-series": series.unique_id }));

        if (forecastPath) svg.append(svgNode("path", { d: forecastPath, class: "chart-line", "data-kind": "forecast", "data-series": series.unique_id }));
      }

      function renderAcceptance(section, acceptance) {
        const summary = root.querySelector(".acceptance-summary");
        const body = root.querySelector(".station-acceptance tbody");
        const socMae = root.querySelector(".model-soc-mae");
        body.replaceChildren();
        [".load-mape-value", ".soc-mape-value", ".baseline-value", ".improvement-value"].forEach((selector) => root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((node) => text(node, "—")));

        text(root.querySelector(".compare-model-value"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector(".compare-baseline-value"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector(".baseline-note-value"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector(".current-mape-note"), "尚无已完成评估窗口");
        text(root.querySelector(".soc-mape-note"), "尚无已完成评估窗口");
        root.querySelector(".model-bar").style.width = "0%";
        root.querySelector(".baseline-bar").style.width = "0%";

        }
        text(summary, `${acceptance.completed_days} / ${acceptance.expected_days} 天 · ${OUTCOME_LABELS[acceptance.status]}`);
        const loadResult = acceptance.results.find((result) => result.unique_id === "station_total_load");
        const socResult = acceptance.results.find((result) => result.unique_id === "storage_soc");
        const currentMapeValue = loadResult && loadResult.mape_percent !== null ? `${metric(loadResult.mape_percent)}%` : "—";
        root.querySelectorAll(".load-mape-value").forEach((node) => text(node, currentMapeValue));
        text(root.querySelector(".compare-model-value"), currentMapeValue);
        text(root.querySelector(".current-mape-note"), loadResult ? `${loadResult.valid_count} / ${loadResult.expected_count} 个有效对比点` : "尚无已完成评估窗口");
        const socMapeValue = socResult && socResult.mape_percent !== null ? `${metric(socResult.mape_percent)}%` : "—";
        root.querySelectorAll(".soc-mape-value").forEach((node) => text(node, socMapeValue));
        text(root.querySelector(".soc-mape-note"), socResult ? `${socResult.valid_count} / ${socResult.expected_count} 个有效对比点` : "尚无已完成评估窗口");
        text(socMae, socResult ? `${metric(socResult.mae)}%` : "—");
        acceptance.results.forEach((result) => {
          const row = document.createElement("tr");
          row.className = "acceptance-result-row";
          row.dataset.series = result.unique_id;
          const values = [
            SERIES_LABELS[result.unique_id], `${result.valid_count} / ${result.expected_count}`, String(result.zero_actual_count),
            result.mape_percent === null ? "—" : `${metric(result.mape_percent)}%`, metric(result.mae),
            result.smape_percent === null ? "—" : `${metric(result.smape_percent)}%`,
            result.wape_percent === null ? "—" : `${metric(result.wape_percent)}%`,
            result.median_ape_percent === null ? "—" : `${metric(result.median_ape_percent)}%`,
            result.p90_ape_percent === null ? "—" : `${metric(result.p90_ape_percent)}%`,
            OUTCOME_LABELS[result.outcome],
          ];
          values.forEach((value) => { const cell = document.createElement("td"); text(cell, value); row.append(cell); });
          body.append(row);
        });
      }

      function renderReadiness(section, station) {
        const hint = root.querySelector(".readiness-hint");
        const meta = root.querySelector(".readiness-meta");
        const progress = root.querySelector(".readiness-track span");
        const visible = station.readiness !== null && ["ready", "initializing"].includes(station.system.state);
        if (!visible) {
          text(hint, "—");
          text(meta, "—");
          hint.hidden = true;
          meta.hidden = true;
          progress.style.width = "0%";
          return;
        }
        text(
          hint,
          station.system.state === "ready"
            ? "已达到 Ready 条件"
            : `距离 Ready 约 ${station.readiness.remaining_days.toFixed(1)} 天`,
        );
        text(meta, `有效历史 ${station.readiness.available_days.toFixed(1)} / ${station.readiness.required_days} 天`);
        progress.style.width = `${Math.min(100, station.readiness.available_days / station.readiness.required_days * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
        hint.hidden = false;
        meta.hidden = false;
      }

      function renderHighlights(section, station) {
        const load = station.series[0];
        const soc = station.series[1];
        const loadActual = validActual(load);
        const socActual = validActual(soc);
        const currentLoad = loadActual.length ? loadActual.at(-1) : null;
        const currentSoc = socActual.length ? socActual.at(-1) : null;
        const peakLoad = extremeForecast(load, "maximum");
        const lowLoad = extremeForecast(load, "minimum");
        const minimumSoc = extremeForecast(soc, "minimum");

        text(section.querySelector(".metric-peak-load"), valueText("station_total_load", peakLoad?.value ?? null));
        text(section.querySelector(".peak-time"), timeOnly(peakLoad?.target_time ?? null));
        text(section.querySelector(".metric-minimum-soc"), valueText("storage_soc", minimumSoc?.value ?? null));
        text(section.querySelector(".minimum-soc-time"), timeOnly(minimumSoc?.target_time ?? null));

        text(section.querySelector(".summary-peak-title"), peakLoad ? `${timeOnly(peakLoad.target_time)} 预计达到负载峰值` : "暂无负载峰值预测");
        text(section.querySelector(".summary-peak-copy"), peakLoad && currentLoad
          ? `预计负载将由当前 ${valueText("station_total_load", currentLoad.value)} 变化至 ${valueText("station_total_load", peakLoad.value)}。`
          : "预测窗口暂无足够的有效负载数据。");
        text(section.querySelector(".summary-soc-title"), minimumSoc ? `${timeOnly(minimumSoc.target_time)} SOC 预计降至 ${valueText("storage_soc", minimumSoc.value)}` : "暂无 SOC 最低点预测");
        text(section.querySelector(".summary-soc-copy"), minimumSoc && currentSoc
          ? `当前 SOC 为 ${valueText("storage_soc", currentSoc.value)}；最低点来自未来 24 小时预测，页面未配置风险阈值。`
          : "预测窗口暂无足够的有效 SOC 数据。");
        text(section.querySelector(".summary-low-title"), lowLoad ? `${timeOnly(lowLoad.target_time)} 预计处于负载低位` : "暂无负载低位预测");
        text(section.querySelector(".summary-low-copy"), lowLoad
          ? `预测窗口最低负载约为 ${valueText("station_total_load", lowLoad.value)}，可供 M4 策略生成时参考。`
          : "预测窗口暂无足够的有效负载数据。");
      }

      function renderStation(station) {
        const section = root.querySelector(".station-section");
        section.dataset.station = station.station_key;
        section.dataset.state = station.system.state;
        text(section.querySelector("h2"), station.station_name);
        text(section.querySelector(".station-status"), STATE_LABELS[station.system.state]);
        renderReadiness(section, station);
        text(section.querySelector(".history-window"), station.range.history_start ? `${dateTime(station.range.history_start)} — ${dateTime(station.range.history_end)}` : "—");
        text(section.querySelector(".forecast-start"), dateTime(station.range.forecast_start));
        text(section.querySelector(".actual-latest"), dateTime(station.range.actual_latest));
        station.series.forEach((series) => {
          const card = section.querySelector(`.series-card[data-series="${series.unique_id}"]`);
          card.dataset.status = series.status;
          text(card.querySelector(".series-status"), SERIES_STATE_LABELS[series.status]);
          const actualPoints = validActual(series);
          const latestActual = actualPoints.length ? actualPoints.at(-1) : null;
          text(card.querySelector(".actual-value"), valueText(series.unique_id, latestActual?.value ?? null));
          text(card.querySelector(".actual-time"), timeOnly(latestActual?.data_time ?? null));
          text(card.querySelector(".forecast-value"), valueText(series.unique_id, series.forecast.length ? series.forecast[0].value : null));
          text(card.querySelector(".model-name"), series.model_name ?? "—");
          text(card.querySelector(".fallback"), `回退：${series.fallback_reason ?? "无"}`);
          renderChart(section, series, station.range);
        });
        const currentModel = station.series[0].model_name ?? station.series[1].model_name ?? "—";
        root.querySelectorAll(".current-model-name").forEach((node) => text(node, currentModel));
        root.querySelectorAll(".candidate").forEach((candidate) => {
          const selected = candidate.dataset.model === currentModel;
          candidate.classList.toggle("selected", selected);
          if (selected) text(candidate.querySelector(".candidate-state"), "当前选中");
        });
        renderHighlights(section, station);
        renderAcceptance(section, station.acceptance);
      }

      function renderError(message = "预测数据暂不可用") {
        hasRenderedDashboard = false;
        lastDashboard = null;
        root.dataset.state = "error";
        text(root.querySelector("#system-state"), "错误");
        text(root.querySelector("#healthy-count"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector("#station-count"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector("#generated-at"), "最近更新：—");
        text(errorState, message);
        errorState.hidden = false;
        root.querySelectorAll(".station-section").forEach(clearSection);
      }

      function renderRefreshError(message) {
        if (!hasRenderedDashboard) {
          renderError(message);
          return;
        }
        text(errorState, message);
        errorState.hidden = false;
      }

      function renderDashboard(value, preserveLastGood = false) {
        try {
          const dashboard = validateDashboard(value);
          root.dataset.state = dashboard.system.state;
          errorState.hidden = true;
          text(root.querySelector("#system-state"), STATE_LABELS[dashboard.system.state]);
          text(root.querySelector("#healthy-count"), String(dashboard.system.healthy_station_count));
          text(root.querySelector("#station-count"), String(dashboard.system.station_count));
          text(root.querySelector("#generated-at"), `最近更新：${dateTime(dashboard.system.generated_at)}`);
          lastDashboard = dashboard;
          initializeTaskDates(dashboard.system.generated_at);
          selectStation(stationPicker.value);
          hasRenderedDashboard = true;
          return true;
        } catch (_error) {
          if (preserveLastGood) renderRefreshError("预测数据加载失败");
          else renderError();
          return false;
        }
      }

      async function loadDashboard() {
        if (authMode === "postmessage" && apiToken === null) {
          renderRefreshError("登录凭证不可用");
          return;
        }
        if (inFlight) return inFlight;
        const requestToken = apiToken;
        const requestHeaders = { Accept: "application/json" };
        if (authMode === "postmessage") requestHeaders.Authorization = `Bearer ${requestToken}`;
        inFlight = (async () => {
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10_000);
          try {
            const response = await fetch(API_PATH, {
              method: "GET",
              cache: "no-store",
              redirect: "error",
              referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
              credentials: "omit",
              headers: requestHeaders,
              signal: controller.signal,
            });
            if (response.status === 401 && authMode === "postmessage") {
              requestAuthentication();
              const authError = new Error("current-user authentication expired");
              authError.name = "M3AuthError";
              throw authError;
            }
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("dashboard request failed");
            const envelope = await response.json();
            scanShape(envelope);
            exactObject(envelope, ["status", "data"], "response envelope");
            assert(envelope.status === "ok", "response status invalid");
            renderDashboard(envelope.data, true);
          } finally {
            window.clearTimeout(timeout);
          }
        })().catch((error) => renderRefreshError(
          error && error.name === "AbortError"
            ? "请求超时"
            : error && error.name === "M3AuthError"
              ? "登录状态已失效"
              : "预测数据加载失败",
        )).finally(() => { inFlight = null; });
        return inFlight;
      }

      function startRefreshTimer() {
        if (refreshTimer !== null) return;
        refreshTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
          if (document.visibilityState === "visible") void loadDashboard();
        }, 60_000);
      }

      function requestAuthentication() {
        if (disposed || authMode !== "postmessage" || parentOrigin === null) return;
        apiToken = null;
        authNonce = newAuthNonce();
        if (authTimeout !== null) window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
        const requestedNonce = authNonce;
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: "vifa-m3-auth-ready", nonce: requestedNonce }, parentOrigin);
        authTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (authNonce !== requestedNonce) return;
          authNonce = null;
          authTimeout = null;
          renderRefreshError("登录凭证不可用");
        }, 10_000);
      }

      function receiveAuthentication(event) {
        if (disposed || authMode !== "postmessage" || parentOrigin === null) return;
        if (event.source !== window.parent || event.origin !== parentOrigin) return;
        if (!exactAuthMessage(event.data, ["type", "nonce", "token"])) return;
        if (event.data.type !== "vifa-m3-auth-token" || event.data.nonce !== authNonce) return;
        if (!validApiToken(event.data.token)) return;
        apiToken = event.data.token;
        authNonce = null;
        if (authTimeout !== null) {
          window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
          authTimeout = null;
        }
        startRefreshTimer();
        void loadDashboard();
      }

      window.renderDashboard = renderDashboard;
      window.renderError = renderError;
      window.loadDashboard = loadDashboard;
      window.addEventListener("message", receiveAuthentication);
      window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
        disposed = true;
        apiToken = null;
        authNonce = null;
        if (authTimeout !== null) window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
        if (refreshTimer !== null) window.clearInterval(refreshTimer);
        themeToggle.removeEventListener("click", toggleTheme);
        stationPicker.removeEventListener("change", changeStation);
        detailsToggle.removeEventListener("click", toggleDetails);
        [historyStart, historyEnd, forecastDays, granularity].forEach((control) => control.removeEventListener("change", updateTaskConfiguration));
        window.removeEventListener("message", receiveAuthentication);
      }, { once: true });
      if (parentOrigin === null || authMode === null) renderError("页面配置不可用");
      else if (authMode === "server_token") {
        startRefreshTimer();
        void loadDashboard();
      } else requestAuthentication();
    })();
